name: NOOP (personal fork)
subtitle: One person's redesigned build of NOOP. Not the official source.
description: Builds of a personal fork of NOOP, the independent open-source WHOOP companion (https://github.com/ryanbr/noop). Compiled by GitHub Actions from https://github.com/shadhahshahid/noop. Unofficial and unsupported; the official source is the one to use unless this fork is yours.

apps.name: NOOP
apps.subtitle: Read your own WHOOP strap, fully offline.
apps.localizedDescription: A personal fork of NOOP with a redesigned interface. It reads a WHOOP strap you own directly over Bluetooth, with no account and no cloud; everything stays on your iPhone. Not affiliated with WHOOP or with the NOOP project.

versions.localizedDescription: Flat rings and bars on Today, plain symbols in list rows, the same flat ring on Sleep, bare scores on the tiles, and one Charge across Today and Data.
Release Data: a Data home with search and headline numbers, and a Training screen (weekly load, intensity mix, markers, stretch streak). Includes releases Look, Runs and HIIT.
Release HIIT: no-setup HIIT with rounds from heart rate, double-tap station marks, a session summary with tags, and a quiet Yoga and Stretch card. Includes releases Look and Runs.
Release Runs: new Train tab, run modes (Zone, Pace, Intervals, Free) and a heart-rate and pace coach that buzzes the strap. Includes release Look.
Release Look: every screen tidied to match Today. Plain titles, one header per section, neutral numbers, no outlines, Workouts filters folded away.

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: NOOP connects directly to your WHOOP strap over Bluetooth to read heart rate, R-R intervals, battery, and sensor data locally on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: NOOP reads your own Apple Health data on-device to compute recovery, strain, and sleep. Nothing leaves your device.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: NOOP writes the metrics it computes from your strap back into Apple Health, on-device and only when you allow it.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: NOOP records your route during an outdoor workout to show distance, pace, and a map, and keeps recording while the screen is off. The route stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: NOOP uses the microphone to let you ask the coach a question by voice. The audio is transcribed on-device and never leaves your iPhone.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: NOOP reads your iPhone's step count for a walking or running workout to show steps in the activity summary. It stays on your device. Nothing leaves it.
privacy.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: NOOP transcribes your question on-device so you can ask the coach out loud instead of typing. Audio never leaves your iPhone.
